name: shipyard
description: Reads the deploys of a Shipyard CI project (their tasks as steps, their JUnit results); starts, stops and runs them again. Shipyard has no roll back.

url.help: the Shipyard address, such as https://ci.example.com

project.help: the Shipyard project, such as shop

key.help: a Shipyard API key (sent as X-Shipyard-Key)
